title: Saints Peter and Paul
alt_text: A marble relief of two men shown in profile, facing each other. The figure on the left has short, curly hair and a short, curly beard. The figure on the right has long hair and a long, flowing beard. Above the men is a carved bird with wings spread out. Text is carved into the top left and top right corners of the rectangular stone tablet. A thin, vertical band crosses the center of the piece, separating the two figures.

title: Virgin and Child with Angels
alt_text: A painting shows a woman sitting on a throne and holding a small child. The woman wears a large, deep blue robe that flows down to the ground. A bright gold halo surrounds her head, and a matching halo surrounds the child's head. Four angelic figures with small wings stand around the throne behind them. Three gold vases sit in a row on the floor at the very bottom of the painting. A clear vertical line splits the entire image down the center, revealing wear and gaps in the wood surface.

title: Evening in the Meadow
alt_text: A painting of a herd of cattle standing in a wide, grassy field. The scene is captured in black and white, showing several cows clustered in the middle ground under a dark, moody, and cloudy sky. In the foreground, one cow stands slightly separated from the rest, facing to the left with its side visible. A distant, low hill stretches across the horizon line. The entire scene is enclosed within a thick, highly detailed, and ornate decorative frame.

title: Architecture, Painting, and Sculpture Protected by Athena from the Ravages of Time
alt_text: A plaster sculpture of a circular relief shows a group of figures clustered together. In the center, a large seated figure faces forward, draped in fabric that falls over their lap. Several smaller standing or reclining figures surround the central figure, filling the round frame. The surface is textured and light-colored, creating a contrast against the dark background behind it. The scene appears crowded, with overlapping limbs and folds of clothing carving out the shapes.

title: Architecture, Painting, and Sculpture Protected by Athena from the Ravages of Time
alt_text: A sculpture of light brown material shows a circular relief featuring several figures. In the center, a group of people sits together, their forms slightly worn and indistinct. To the left, a person reclines with their legs bent, while other figures stand or sit behind the central group. The material has a smooth, shiny texture, with some cracks visible across the surface. The entire scene is contained within a round border.

title: James Gamble Rogers
alt_text: A painting of an older man with glasses who is sitting in a chair. He is wearing a dark jacket over a light-colored vest, a white shirt, and a red tie. His right hand rests on his knee, while his left hand holds a piece of paper with architectural drawings on it. The man looks directly forward with a serious expression. Behind him, a faint, sketch-like image of a city skyline with tall towers appears on the right side. The background is a simple, dark brown tone.

title: Head of Vespasian after a Roman portrait type of the 1st Century A.D.
alt_text: A marble sculpture of a man's head and neck faces directly forward. The sculpture is made of pale, tan-colored stone with visible veining throughout the surface. The man has a broad face, heavy features, and deep lines around his mouth and cheeks. A simple white cloth is tied around the base of the neck, and a hand with bandaged fingers is visible at the very bottom edge of the frame. The entire piece sits on top of a dark blue, quilted fabric background.

title: Self-Portrait of the Artist Painting His Wife (Sarah Annis Sully)
alt_text: A painting of a man and a woman posed close together. The man is in the foreground on the right, wearing a dark brown coat with a reddish shirt collar visible underneath. He has light skin and curly brown hair, and he looks directly toward the viewer. Behind him and to his left, a woman with fair skin and brown hair is visible. She wears a thin, sheer white veil that drapes over her head and shoulders, making her appear slightly blurred or ghostly. A hand belonging to the woman is visible in the bottom left corner, holding a thin, light-colored object like a stylus or brush.

title: Judge Matthias Burnet Tallmadge (1774-1819), B.A. 1795
alt_text: A painting of a man sitting in a chair. He is shown from the waist up, facing forward with his head slightly turned to the side. He wears a dark coat over a white shirt with a ruffled collar. The man holds an open book in his hands, resting it on his lap. He sits in a reddish-brown chair against a dark background, framed by a thick, ornate gold frame.

title: Andrew Jackson (1767-1845)
alt_text: A painting of a man with light, swept-back hair looking slightly to the left. He has a serious expression and deep, set-in eyes. He wears a dark, high-collared coat with a reddish-brown cape or cloak draped over his shoulders. The background is a dim, moody blur of dark colors. The portrait is framed in an ornate, gold-colored rectangular frame.

title: General Winfield Scott (1786-1866)
alt_text: A painting of a man sitting on horseback in a outdoor scene. The man wears a dark, formal military uniform with buttons and tall boots. He has short hair, a mustache, and a serious expression. The dark horse stands on uneven, rocky ground facing to the left. A faint, hazy landscape with trees is visible in the background.

title: Chair Used at Coronation of George VI
medium: Velvet, blue with embroidered insignia, oak
alt_text: A piece of furniture, specifically a chair made of dark wood and covered in deep blue velvet. The chair has a square backrest and a flat, square seat. Both the top edge of the backrest and the bottom edge of the seat are trimmed with thick, light-colored piping. On the upper left corner of the backrest, there is a golden embroidered design featuring a crown above stylized letters. The chair stands on four simple, straight wooden legs against a plain wall.

title: The Apotheosis of Saint Roch
alt_text: A painting of several figures floating in the sky in an oval frame. In the center, a person in a bright red cloak extends both arms upward with their head tilted back. Below them, a smaller figure with dark hair reaches out, while other partially draped figures with wings cluster around in shades of white, green, and gold. The background features patches of light blue sky and darker, cloud-like textures, creating a sense of movement. The entire scene is framed by a solid, muted border that contrasts with the lighter center.

title: Classic and Romantic Art
medium: Plaster, gilded, shellacked, and mounted on cloth
alt_text: A plaster sculpture shows a scene with several human figures set against a dark blue oval background. In the center, a man stands with a large, golden sunburst emanating from behind his head. To his left, an older bearded man sits, while a younger person stands beside him. To the man's right, two more figures stand together, with one appearing to reach upward. The figures have pale, off-white surfaces and stand atop textured, cloud-like formations. A golden bird-like creature sits near the feet of the central figure.

title: Classic and Romantic Art
medium: Plaster, painted, shellacked, and mounted on cloth
alt_text: A plaster sculpture of a relief scene shaped like an oval. The sculpture shows three main human figures standing in the center and on the sides. The central figure stands tall with rays extending outward from behind its head. To the left and right of the center, two other figures stand among wavy, cloud-like shapes. Below the central figure, a smaller bird-like creature rests on the clouds. The entire scene is beige and has a slightly glossy, textured surface.

title: Classic and Romantic Art
alt_text: A plaster relief shows a scene featuring several figures in an oval frame. In the center, a standing figure with arms raised appears to be surrounded by light rays and stands atop a rounded shape. To the left, another figure stands facing inward with one arm reaching out toward the center. On the right, two figures are posed close together, with one reaching out and another partially obscured behind them. The entire scene is set against a background of cloud-like forms. The sculpture is light in color, creating a contrast with the dark surface beneath it.

title: Cartouche with Two Male Figures
alt_text: A plaster sculpture shows two figures positioned together within a decorative frame. The figures are seated and appear to be draped in cloth that fans out behind them. Below the figures is a curved, arch-like structure that has a noticeable crack running through it. The entire object has a light, tan color and a slightly glossy finish. The piece is set against a dark gray background.

title: Cartouche with Two Male Figures
alt_text: A plaster sculpture shows a relief panel with a decorative border and a central figure. The rectangular, off-white piece has a curved cutout at the bottom edge. A carved floral chain runs along the left and right vertical sides of the frame. In the center, a sculpted figure with a missing head and torso is positioned next to an oval shape. A swirled ribbon or banner design stretches across the top of the central area.

title: Cartouche with Two Male Figures
alt_text: A plaster and plasticine sculpture shows a decorative panel with carvings in relief. The rectangular panel features a large circular frame in its lower center that is mostly empty. Above the circle, two figures sit next to each other, their bodies angled slightly upward. They are framed by draped fabric that hangs down along the left and right sides of the panel. A repeating pattern of small, round shapes resembling flower blossoms or masks runs vertically along the left and right borders.

title: Cartouche with Two Male Figures
alt_text: A sculpture of a relief plaque made of plaster shows two figures centered in a frame. The two figures, which appear to be winged and nude, face each other and hold up a large oval shape behind them. Long garlands of flowers or leaves hang down both the left and right sides of the frame. At the bottom of the piece, there is a prominent curved cutout section. The overall color is a light, warm beige, and the surface has a smooth, shiny finish.
